scoring.aggregation: sum of each player's best accepted run per track and direction
scoring.ties: equal unrounded totals share a rank; subsequent ranks skip tied positions

rules.qualifying_reigns: all lifetime reigns; no release-date cutoff
rules.reign_dates: verification dates; successive self-improvements remain one continuous reign
rules.total_wr_hours: all lifetime reigns on eligible tracks, including short reigns and the launch period, added across tracks
rules.online_requirement: top three after the online ranking's initial three months; owner-confirmed config
